title: Bound workspace file-change batches and provide explicit overflow recovery
outcome: A long file-change burst cannot grow one pending map or workspaceFilesChanged SSE frame without bound, and clients recover skipped detail explicitly.
acceptance: Existing watcher/coalescer enforces cardinality, byte and flush-time budgets before pending changes or serialized frames grow beyond their bounds.

Overflow produces an explicit scoped invalidation/rescan signal through the existing file-events owner; revision ordering and completeness are preserved and no silent successful full-change-list claim is made.
Clients refresh affected directory/Git views through bounded reads; active-turn file-change metadata also remains bounded without weakening required write-observation evidence.
Boundary and long-burst tests use small budgets; independent review and full gate pass.
